page.overview:
Who is Nezuko Kamado?

Nezuko is a young girl with fair skin, visibly large prominent fangs, a slender build, and sharp stiletto nails with a base color of light pink and ombre transitioning to a red-orange color at the tips. Her hair is long, black, and wavy. It reaches just below her waist, turning a flame-orange color as it passes her elbows, and appears to be crimped into large straight ridges, worn side-swept drastically to her left. She has soft-looking pink pupils that appear a lighter color around the rims of their irises and a persian pink center; they slanted downwards toward the sides of her face and framed by notably long eyelashes. In the manga, Nezuko can sometimes be shown with more than one bow. According to Tanjiro, Nezuko was known as a great beauty in their home town.

She wears a light pink, short-sleeve kimono with an asanoha (hemp leaf) pattern, the lining a paler pink layered with the white wavy yuban underneath as a medium-length trailing skirt kimono to freely move as a demon; this, the white clothes lowly cover her knees then goes down to almost her ankles making a open window, secured by a red and white-chequered hanhaba obi with an orange-threaded obijime and a green obiage. Over this, she sports a long dark-brown haori that reaches her calves, as well as a pair of zōri with pink straps and white tabi socks, wrapped with thick pieces of black material resembling kyahan. Nezuko also wears a small pink ribbon on the left side of her head to keep her hair out of her face, along with the bamboo muzzle Giyu Tomioka gave her, which is secured around her jaw with a strip of red cloth.

When Nezuko transforms into her awakened form during her fight with Daki, she gains a bigger, taller, and more curvaceous body. As a result, she outgrows her attire, tearing the sleeves of her kimono and the left sleeve of her haori. In addition, she loses her bamboo muzzle and her right footwear. She grows a short white horn on the right side of her forehead, designed with an irregular crack pattern, along with vein-like patterns in her forehead near her horn. She has a vein-like pattern around her left eye. In addtion, she has black cat-like slit pupils, along with crack-like patterns around the rim of her irises. Her most striking new feature is the red and green vine-like pattern that covers her skin, circling around her arms, legs, and chest.

After gaining immunity from sunlight and regaining her ability to speak, Nezuko retains mostly the same appearance. Exceptions include the removal of her bamboo muzzle and her eyes, which now have black, cat-like pupils with visible cracks.

Also known as: Nezuko.
